pages.text: Points to your own nearest totem, however far. Load it with Shatter Coins and start tracking, and for a while it points to the nearest rival totem within its reach instead.$(br2)After tracking it needs to cool down: 10 minutes on an untuned compass.

A compass finds rival totems only within its $(l)reach$(): 100 blocks from you across the ground and 10 above or below, untuned.$(br2)A $(l:totem/compass_tuner)Compass Tuner$() tunes more into it, up to 2,500 and 150, and a cooldown down to 3 minutes. Its screen says whether it is tuned.
pages.title: Reach

pages.text: While tracking, the needle points to a rival totem in your reach whose $(l:totem/radiation)radiation$() reaches you.$(br2)With none, but a rival's radiation detected, the needle turns slowly and $(l)Totem radiation detected$() shows above your hotbar.$(br2)Otherwise it wobbles.
pages.title: Reading the compass

pages.text: Pips on the compass in your hotbar count its tuned levels: turquoise along the bottom for across, gold up the side for up or down.
pages.title: Level pips
